## Database changes

<!-- Delete this section if there are none. -->

- [ ] New script(s) in `database/migrations/` with the next free number, additive, and no merged script was edited or renamed
- [ ] Procedures, functions, views, and triggers have one `CREATE OR ALTER` file each in `database/<type>/<Module>/`
- [ ] The migrator runs twice without errors (`dotnet run --project database/Itacr.Database.Migrator`), and the second run applies nothing

## Checklist

- [ ] The solution builds in Release with no warnings (`dotnet build -c Release`)
- [ ] Format check and tests pass (`dotnet format --verify-no-changes`, `dotnet test`)
- [ ] Follows [docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md](../docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md)
- [ ] Every new endpoint validates its input and is documented in OpenAPI (response types and status codes)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env`, or connection strings with real passwords committed; `.env.example` and `appsettings.json` updated if a setting was added
- [ ] Offline sync still works if the change touches order creation (idempotency key)
- [ ] Error messages shown to end users are in Spanish; code, comments, and docs are in English
- [ ] Docs updated (README) if applicable. `CHANGELOG.md` is generated by release-please
